attributes.name: active nav item treatment
attributes.definition: How the currently active/highlighted navigation item is visually styled.

values.definition: Active item has a solid background fill, tab-like (possibly with rounded top corners), contrasting with other items.
Active item marked by a line/underline/border only.
Active item differs only by text color or weight.
No distinct active state, or another treatment.

attributes.name: nav accent color
attributes.definition: Hue family used as the accent in the navigation (active state, rules).

values.definition: Muted gold, khaki or yellow-brown accent.

attributes.name: nav bar background and rule
attributes.definition: Background of the nav strip and whether it has a bottom rule.

values.value: light background with colored bottom rule
values.definition: Near-white/light strip with a colored bottom border.
Light strip with no accent rule.
Nav strip filled with dark or brand color.

attributes.name: inactive nav item styling
attributes.definition: How non-active nav items are styled.

values.definition: Items appear as plain text with no styling.

codes.value: light background with colored bottom rule
